newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian 252-day t-bill yields average 33.58 pct.
newsitem.headline: Russian 252-day t-bill yields average 33.58 pct.

text.p: The annualised average yield on an issue of 252-day GKO discount Treasury bills (series 22080) was 33.58 percent at an auction on Wednesday, the Central Bank said.
The series 22074 bills, maturing on December 10, the closest maturity date to the new issue, closed on Tuesday at 82.25 to yield an average 32.96 percent.
Dealers had forecast the annualised average yield for the bills would be 32.60 to 33.73 percent.
Full details of the auction follow:
Later on Wednesday the Finance Ministry will also auction four trillion roubles of an additional 147-day tranche of series 22076 Treasury bills.
The Finance Ministry is also paying 403.76 billion roubles in interest on the two-year series 24008 OFZ interest-bearing government bond maturing in July 1998.
It will repay 7.39 trillion roubles in the series 22049 T-bills which mature on Wednesday.
